svg.title: Cartouche: elevation · close-up in context
svg.desc: Elevation of a Baroque cartouche: an oval field for an inscription or coat of arms within a beaded rim and a band of fluting, with scrolls (volutes) at the corners, leaves, a shell crest, swags and a hanging drop, with a round close-up of one upper scroll and its leaf. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CLOSE-UP · ×2 · FIELD 800 × 1040 mm · SCROLLS AT FOUR CORNERS
ORNAMENTAL FRAME FOR AN INSCRIPTION OR ARMS
SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
